jobs.title: Metallbauer:in / Nautiker:in Thun
jobs.description:
Wir mögen Seen, wir mögen die Natur, wir mögen unsere Gäste – und wir mögen Menschen, die mit uns gemeinsam zur erfolgreichen Zukunft der BLS Schifffahrt beitragen wollen. Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein einzigartiges, abwechslungsreiches und stabiles Umfeld. Mit uns lassen sich neue Horizonte entdecken, indem du bei uns die Möglichkeit erhältst, deine handwerkliche Passion mit einer nautischen Ausbildung zum Matrosen, Maschinist oder sogar Schiffsführer zu ergänzen.

Das wartet auf dich:

• Unsere nationalen und internationalen Gäste überzeugend und kompetent beraten und betreuen

• Kontrolle und Verkauf von Fahrausweisen

• Vor- und Nachbereitung der Schiffe

• Mitarbeit im nautischen Dienst (wir bilden dich aus)

• Instandhaltung und Erneuerung unserer Flotte im Winterhalbjahr

Das bringst du mit:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung Metallbauer:in EFZ, Erfahrung beim Schweissen und Konstruieren sowie einige Jahre Berufserfahrung

• Führerausweis Kategorie B

• Freude am Umgang mit Gästen aus verschiedenen Kulturen

• Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gut Deutsch, mündliche Englisch- & Französischkenntnisse (oder Bereitschaft diese zu erlernen)

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheits- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Bereitschaft für unregelmässige Arbeitseinsätze (Wochenende / Abend)

Deine Vorteile – darauf kannst du dich freuen:

• Erhalte ein GA 2. Klasse oder ein Halbtaxabo sowie attraktive Fahrvergünstigungen für die Familie und kostenlose internationale Freifahrscheine.

• Du hast Freizeit, wenn andere arbeiten. Du kannst Teilzeit arbeiten, und für Pensen in der Nacht und am Wochenende gibt es Zuschläge.

• Es besteht die Möglichkeit, fünf bis zehn Ferientage pro Jahr zusätzlich zu kaufen.

• Wir beteiligen uns mit 60 Prozent an den Pensionskassenbeiträgen.

• Grosszügige Dienstaltersgeschenke bereits ab fünf Dienstjahren.

• Dich erwartet ein traumhafter Arbeitsort im Herzen des Berner Oberlands.

Über die BLS Schifffahrt

Weisse Schiffe. Blaues Wasser. Frische Luft. Die Bergwelt des Berner Oberlands. Was fast etwas nach Klischee tönt, ist nichts anderes als die Faszination Schifffahrt. Für rund 120 Mitarbeitende am und auf dem Brienzer- und Thunersee ist das Teil der täglichen Realität.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ci piacciono i laghi, ci piace la natura, ci piacciono i nostri ospiti – e ci piacciono le persone che vogliono plasmare attivamente il futuro della spedizione BLS insieme a noi. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un ambiente unico, vario e stabile. Con noi, puoi scoprire nuovi orizzonti dandoci l'opportunità di sviluppare il tuo talento organizzativo in un ambiente dinamico e di modellare in modo decisivo lo sviluppo dei processi operativi.

Ti aspetta:

• I nostri ospiti nazionali e internazionali forniscono consulenza e assistenza convincenti e competenti

• Check e vendita di biglietti

• Preparazione e follow-up delle navi

• Collaborazione nel servizio nautico (ti formiamo)

• Manutenzione e rinnovo della nostra flotta in inverno

Questo è ciò che portate con voi:

• Lavoratori di metalli di formazione completi: in EFZ, esperienza nella saldatura e nella costruzione e diversi anni di esperienza professionale

• Titolo di guida della categoria B

• Godimento di trattare con gli ospiti di diverse culture

• Competenze linguistiche: Molto bene tedesco, orale inglese e francese competenze (o la volontà di imparare loro)

• Forte senso di sicurezza e responsabilità

• Prontezza per incarichi di lavoro irregolari (weekend / sera)

I vostri vantaggi – si può aspettare a:

• Prendi un GA 2. Abbonamento di classe o di mezza quota, nonché interessanti vantaggi di guida per la famiglia e biglietti gratuiti internazionali.

• Hai tempo libero quando gli altri lavorano. È possibile lavorare part-time, e ci sono supplementi per i pensionati di notte e nei fine settimana.

• È possibile acquistare un ulteriore cinque a dieci giorni di vacanza all'anno.

• Contribuiamo il 60% dei contributi del fondo pensione.

• Regali generosi di anzianità da cinque anni di servizio.

• Un luogo di lavoro onirico vi aspetta nel cuore dell'Oberland Bernese.

Informazioni sulla spedizione BLS

Navi bianche. Acqua blu. Aria fresca. Le montagne dell'Oberland Bernese. Ciò che quasi suona come cliché non è altro che il fascino della spedizione. Per circa 120 dipendenti sul lago Brienzer e Thunersee, questo fa parte della realtà quotidiana.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We like lakes, we like nature, we like our guests – and we like people who want to actively shape the future of BLS shipping together with us. We offer our employees a unique, varied and stable environment. With us, you can discover new horizons by giving us the opportunity to develop your organizational talent in a dynamic environment and to shape the development of operational processes decisively.

This is waiting for you:

• Our national and international guests provide convincing and competent advice and care

• Checks and sales of tickets

• Preparation and follow-up of ships

• Collaboration in nautical service (we train you)

• Maintenance and renewal of our fleet in winter

This is what you bring with you:

• Completed training metalworkers: in EFZ, experience in welding and construction as well as several years of professional experience

• Category B driving licence

• Enjoyment of dealing with guests from different cultures

• Language skills: Very good German, oral English & French skills (or willingness to learn them)

• Strong sense of security and responsibility

• Readiness for irregular work assignments (weekend / evening)

Your advantages – you can look forward to:

• Get a GA 2. Class or a half-tax subscription as well as attractive driving benefits for the family and free international free tickets.

• You have free time when others work. You can work part-time, and there are surcharges for boarders at night and on weekends.

• It is possible to buy an additional five to ten holiday days per year.

• We contribute 60 percent of the pension fund contributions.

• Generous gifts of seniority from five years of service.

• A dreamlike place of work awaits you in the heart of the Bernese Oberland.

About BLS shipping

White ships. Blue water. Fresh air. The mountains of the Bernese Oberland. What almost sounds like cliché is nothing more than the fascination of shipping. For around 120 employees on and on Lake Brienzer and Thunersee, this is part of daily reality.

titleByLocale.en: Service technician: in ventilation and air conditioning
titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de service: dans la ventilation et la climatisation

jobs.description:
Die Gebäudelüftungsanlagen unseres Lötschberg Basistunnels und dem Streckennetz der BLS Netz AG sind wichtige Mosaiksteine im eng verzahnten Räderwerk der BLS. Mit deinem Wissen und Können sorgst du für einwandfrei funktionierende Anlagen und ermöglichst dadurch unseren Kund:innen ein optimales Reiseerlebnis.

Das wartet auf dich:

• Ausführung der Instandhaltung für die Gebäudelüftungsanlagen auf dem Streckennetz der BLS Netz AG & dem Lötschberg Basistunnel LBT

• Neu- und Umbauarbeiten von Gebäudelüftungsanlagen

• Störungsbehebung (2nd-Level) im zugewiesenen Fachbereich

Das bringst du mit:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Kältesystem-Monteur/in oder Elektroinstallateur/in EFZ oder eine äquivalente Ausbildung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in diesem Bereich

• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Wasser-, Luft- und Kälteanlagen

• Elektro-Anschlussbewilligung NIV Art. 15

• Führerausweis der Kategorie B / BE

• Eigenverantwortliche und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Bereitschaft zu Nachteinsätzen (ca. 15 – 20 Schichten pro Jahr)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse

Deine Vorteile – darauf kannst du dich freuen:

• Wir fördern eine möglichst flexible Planung deiner Touren und Schichten

• Erhalte ein GA 2. Klasse, ein GA 1. Klasse oder ein Halbtaxabo.

Progettazione attiva dell'infrastruttura ferroviaria di domani e garantire che i nostri clienti arrivino da A a B in tempo e in sicurezza.

• Prende sopra l'installazione, la manutenzione e la riparazione delle nostre reti elettriche e linee catenarie

• Alzacristalli e gru in modo sicuro e preciso

• Patente di guida Cat. B, posto di lavoro deve essere accessibile entro 45 minuti in auto

• Prontezza per Pikettdienst (circa 6 settimane / anno, 1 anno in anticipo) e servizio notturno (40-50% del tempo di lavoro, 1 mese in anticipo)

• Forte consapevolezza della sicurezza, lavoro di squadra, vertigini e fitness, come spesso si lavora a quota

Con quasi 4.000 dipendenti, BLS è la seconda più grande compagnia ferroviaria in Svizzera. Cosa ci collega? Forte di quello che facciamo ogni giorno. La mobilità ha molte sfaccettature per noi. E molti lavori interessanti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you destined for higher things? We may have something suitable for you: Join as a catenary fitter: join BLS and take your career to new heights! Are you dizzy and like working with heavy equipment? Then this is your chance! Actively design the railway infrastructure of tomorrow and ensure that our customers get from A to B on time and safely.

This is waiting for you:

• Maintain catenary lines and power systems so that our network runs without interruptions

• Takes over the installation, maintenance and repair of our electrical networks and catenary lines

• Remediate disruptions in the allocated railway network quickly and efficiently

• Operating lifts and cranes safely and accurately

• Repair various types of cable faults reliably and quickly

This is what you bring with you:

• Basic craft training (EFZ) and readiness to train as a train driver:in (categories B80/B100) to use cranes and lifts

• Driving licence Cat. B, place of work must be accessible within 45 minutes by car

• Readiness for Pikettdienst (about 6 weeks / year, 1 year planned in advance) and night service (40-50% of working time, 1 month planned in advance)

• Strong safety awareness, teamwork, dizziness and physical fitness, as you often work at altitude

• You are reliable and responsible because it depends on you and your work

Your advantages – you can look forward to:

• We promote the most flexible planning of your tours and shifts possible

• Get a GA 2nd class, a GA 1st class. Class or a half-tax subscription.

• You have free time when others work. For pennies at night and on weekends there are surcharges.

• It is possible to buy an additional five to ten holiday days per year.

• Financial support for external further education and an exciting internal learning and course offer are at your disposal.

• With seasonal events and courses we support your health

About the BLS

With almost 4,000 employees, BLS is the second largest railway company in Switzerland. Moreover, we are also a shipping company, a real estate company, an international freight railway, a bus company and transport cars safely through the Lötschberg and the Simplon. What connects us? Proud of what we do every day. Mobility has many facets for us. And lots of exciting jobs.
